pages.title: hakuna matata
pages.extract:
== English ==


=== Etymology ===

From Swahili hakuna matata (“there are no problems”). Popularized in English by the 1994 Disney film The Lion King.


=== Pronunciation ===
(General American) IPA(key): /həˈkunə məˈtɑtə/


=== Phrase ===
hakuna matata

No worries, take it easy.


== Swahili ==


=== Etymology ===
From hakuna + matata (“troubles”), literally “there are no problems”.


=== Pronunciation ===

(Unguja standard) IPA(key): /hɑˈku.nɑ mɑˈtɑ.tɑ/


=== Phrase ===
hakuna matata

(rare) No worries, take it easy, hakuna matata.


==== Usage notes ====
Although this phrase was popularized in the West by the Disney production The Lion King, it is not usually used in conversation.


==== Descendants ====
→ English: hakuna matata
